---
title: "Notes for 10-12"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(nflreadr)
library(tidyverse)
fantasy2025 <- load_player_stats(2025, summary_level = "reg") |>
  dplyr::filter(position %in% c("TE","WR","RB")) |>
  select(player_display_name,recent_team,position,games,
         carries,rushing_yards,rushing_tds,
         receptions,targets,receiving_yards,receiving_tds,
         fantasy_points_ppr)
glimpse(fantasy2025)
```

```{r}
fantasy_kmeans=kmeans(scale(fantasy2025[,4:12]),centers=3,nstart=100)
# fantasy_kmeans$cluster = cluster assignments of data
# fantasy_kmeans$centers = means of each cluster-variable 
# fantasy_kmeans$tot.withinss = total wss across all clusters

```

```{r}
errors=data.frame(centers=1:10,wss=NA)
for (i in 1:10){
  fantasy_kmeans=kmeans(scale(fantasy2025[,4:12]),centers=i,nstart=100)
  errors$wss[i]=fantasy_kmeans$tot.withinss
}
errors |>
  ggplot(aes(x=centers,y=wss))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
# Best 3 cluster model
fantasy_kmeans=kmeans(scale(fantasy2025[,4:12]),centers=3,nstart=100)
centers_df=data.frame(fantasy_kmeans$centers) |>
  mutate(cluster=1:3)|>
  pivot_longer(-cluster,names_to = "statistic",values_to = "value")
centers_df
```

```{r}
centers_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x=statistic,y=value,
             col=factor(cluster),group=cluster))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
centers_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x=statistic,y=factor(cluster),fill=value))+
  geom_tile()+
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "RdBu",
    direction = -1   # red = high, blue = low
  ) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(y = "Cluster", x = NULL)
```

```{r}
# 2D projection (carries,targets)
fantasy2025 |>
  mutate(cluster=fantasy_kmeans$cluster) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=carries,y=targets,col=factor(cluster)))+
  geom_point()
```
